observations.prompt: Inspect images as evidence only. Image 1 is the FINAL EXPORTED frame, image 2 the exact native 96 pixel preview, image 3 the original identity reference (body-heavy old framing is intentionally NOT to be preserved). Localize the PRIMARY visible FACE in image 1: face_box=[left,forehead, right,chin] in coordinates 0..1000 relative to the ENTIRE image 1, excluding hair, neck, ears, shoulders, goggles on the forehead, hat and armour. Do NOT give the whole head/body box. eye_centres=[left_eye_x,left_eye_y,right_eye_x,right_eye_y] same coordinate system, image-left eye first. Report the framing actually visible. Both eyes must be visible; expression must be readable in image 2. Check face identity against image 3, allow changed expression and tighter framing. List concrete defects: small face, obscured eye, mask, deep featureless facial shadow, body-dominant composition, lost identity or anatomy defects. Do not infer compliance from a prompt; measure actual pixels. Empty defect list only if no observed defect. Confidence uses 0, .25, .5, .75, 1. Return required JSON only.
